Update the parameter signatures of default_value and value from a
mutable reference (T &) to a const reference (const T &).

This allows developers to pass temporary rvalues and literals
directly into the functions.

Signed-off-by: Suad Shabaj <suad.shabai@gmail.com>

- Extended the existing Metadata unit test to cover the new signatures.
- Added a case passing a literal default for an existing key.
- Added a case setting a value using a literal instead of a named
  variable.

commit.message:
Static Layer resize_master (#6488)

* Fix StaticLayer maximum merge treating unknown as the highest cost

In the rolling-window path of updateCosts the layer merged with a plain std::max.
NO_INFORMATION (255) is larger than LETHAL_OBSTACLE (254), so an unknown map cell
overwrote lethal cells placed by other layers, and on a master that tracks unknown
space the map's own lethal cells never landed at all. Apply the same rule as
updateWithMax: unknown map cells are transparent and a known cost replaces an
unknown master cell.

Signed-off-by: Tony Najjar <tony.najjar@dexory.com>

* Add StaticLayer overlay mode

New initialization-only parameter resize_master (default true keeps the current
behavior). With resize_master: false on a non-rolling costmap the layer keeps the
map's own size, origin and resolution and is sampled into the master through the
existing rolling-window path, so several OccupancyGrid sources can be layered under
InflationLayer. The layer reports its current and previous extent as bounds so a
replaced or moved map clears what it used to cover.

Signed-off-by: Tony Najjar <tony.najjar@dexory.com>

* Revert "Fix StaticLayer maximum merge treating unknown as the highest cost"

This reverts commit 75bc6dd242c3aa3dd2e7cc59b29e7e2b437dd784.

Signed-off-by: Tony Najjar <tony.najjar@dexory.com>

* Rename sharesMasterGeometry to usesMasterCostmapSize for clarity

Signed-off-by: Tony Najjar <tony.najjar@dexory.com>

* Refactor StaticLayer to remove unused overlay bounds and improve clarity in comments

Signed-off-by: Tony Najjar <tony.najjar@dexory.com>

* Fix StaticLayer to ensure has_updated_data_ is set on TransformException
Rename overlay tests to reflect their purpose in resizing master geometry

Signed-off-by: Tony Najjar <tony.najjar@dexory.com>

* Add tests for StaticLayer to validate master resize behavior and frame rejection

Signed-off-by: Tony Najjar <tony.najjar@dexory.com>

* Refactor StaticLayer to improve boundary calculations and update test cases for resolution changes

Signed-off-by: Tony Najjar <tony.najjar@dexory.com>

---------

Signed-off-by: Tony Najjar <tony.najjar@dexory.com>
